# RemoteJobs44

> RemoteJobs44 is a remote job board focused on Nigerian and African job seekers, with 50,000+ verified remote jobs from global companies.

## What is RemoteJobs44?

RemoteJobs44 (https://remotejobs44.com) is a subscription-based remote job board. Free users can browse jobs; Pro subscribers (from ₦1,000/month) can apply directly. The platform serves job seekers across Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, South Africa, and all of Africa.

## Key features

- 50,000+ remote jobs across engineering, design, marketing, finance, sales, support, writing, and more
- Jobs from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, and Recruitee ATS platforms
- Filter by category, job type (full-time, part-time, contract, freelance), experience level, salary, and region/country
- Application tracker to manage your pipeline
- Affordable pricing in Naira (₦1,000/month for Pro)

## Plans

- Free: Browse all jobs, save favourites
- Pro Monthly: Apply to all jobs, track applications — ₦1,000/month
- Pro Annual: Best value — ₦8,000/year
- Day Pass: 10 applications for 24 hours — ₦500

## Who is it for?

Remote workers in Africa, especially Nigeria, looking for full-time, part-time, contract, or freelance roles with global companies. Ideal for software engineers, designers, marketers, finance professionals, and customer support specialists who want to work remotely.
